units.text: Siblings and cousins of your own age weigh in on family matters this year, and you settle home decisions between equals.
Working alongside equals shows you your own shape this year, and you lean less on anyone's approval and more on your own judgement.
Friends meet you as equals this year, and you spend more time with people who do what you do than with those who look up to you.
Shared purchases and a friend's request for help pull at your money this year, and you decide how much of your own you put in.
Competition runs through your circle this year over the same invitations and attention, and you share your friends more widely than you planned.
Meals, sleep and easy pleasures take a larger share of your days this year, and you feel how closely your body follows the pace you set.
Home gathers around food and easy company this year, and you are the one who cooks, hosts or makes the place feel lived in.
Your thinking sharpens against received ideas this year, and you find flaws in what others accept faster than you can keep them to yourself.
Skill and impatience with the rules arrive together in your job this year, and you say out loud what colleagues only grumble about.
Conversations with friends grow sharper and wittier this year, and you say the thing everyone else at the table was thinking.
Money reaches you this year through side doors like a second job or an unexpected offer, and you spread it across more ventures than usual.
Family life widens this year to relatives far away or newly met, and you spend more of your time and money on people beyond your own home.
Your circle widens this year through chance meetings and friends of friends, and you move easily between groups that never meet each other.
Bills, savings and the slow work of keeping accounts take up more of your attention this year, and you know where each part of your money goes.
Household accounts and the care of family property pass through your hands this year, and you keep the home in careful order.
Steady work and the pay it earns hold your attention this year, and you build your standing through the hours you put in and the details you get right.
Paperwork, signatures and speaking for the household fall to you this year, and you carry family duties in full view of your relatives.
Roles and expectations shape your friendships this year, a committee seat or a host's duty, and you are known for showing up when you said you would.
Odd, specialist subjects pull at your thinking this year, and you study alone what few people around you would think to ask about.
Private study and unusual interests change you this year in ways few people see, and you become more yourself out of public view.
An older relative takes a closer interest in your home this year with help and opinions, and you are looked after more than you asked to be.
Books, courses and a patient teacher fill more of your evenings this year, and you learn most when someone else sets the syllabus.
Your body leans on shelter and routine this year, warm meals and early nights, and you accept more looking after than you usually allow.
